title: Incremental Ingestion with Orphan Cleanup
instructions: Implement `chunk_words`, the `VectorStore` methods and `IndexSync.sync` in `ingest.py` (`Chunk`, `Embedder` and `SyncReport` are provided). Chunk ids are deterministic (`doc_id#index`) and hashed, so a sync embeds only missing or changed chunks in one batched call, deletes orphaned chunk ids, and makes zero embedder calls for an unchanged document.

evidence.label: Chunks have deterministic ids, exact character offsets and the requested word overlap
The last window is not duplicated once it reaches the final word
Invalid size or overlap raises ValueError
Empty text yields no chunks and content_hash is the SHA-256 of the chunk text
A second sync of an unchanged document embeds nothing
Editing the last word re-embeds exactly one chunk
Shrinking a document deletes the orphaned chunks
Syncing one document never touches another, even with a shared id prefix
VectorStore tracks hashes, replaces on upsert and ignores unknown deletes
All changed chunks are embedded in a single batched call
